Subject: SCHICHTGAENGER, living entranced worker with closed eyes, miner lamp and pickaxe. Melancholic never gory. Strict 6 columns x 4 rows equal square cells, full sheet ratio 3:2. Row1 idle four frames then TWO EMPTY transparent cells; row2 attack six frames: raise pickaxe windup, same windup held, swing LEFT, impact, recoil, return; row3 hurt three frames then THREE EMPTY cells; row4 defeat four frames gently kneeling then lying ASLEEP ALIVE, then TWO EMPTY cells. Each character fits inside own cell, same baseline, margins, never overlaps. Facing LEFT. Crisp low resolution 48x48 pixel density each cell. 1px deep blue grey #1a1c2c outline, muted limestone white ochre rust slate grey brass palette max32, top-left lighting 2-3 shade steps, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no text no grids no watermark. Genuine transparent background. Use the attached sprites as strict style reference: same palette, outline color, pixel density, proportions and light direction.
